title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "sec_13f_institutional_whale_insider_tracker" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "SEC 13F Institutional Whale & Insider Tracker: Extracts SEC Form 13F institutional holdings and Form 4 insider trading disclosures." → after: "SEC 13F Institutional Whale & Insider Tracker: Extracts SEC Form 13F institutional holdings (shares and USD value held by each fund) and Form 4 insider trading disclosures for a ticker or company."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
